baselineDisplay.title: A Match (A. C. Swinburne)
baselineDisplay.text:
If love were what the rose is, And I were the leaf, Our lives would grow together In sad or singing weather, Brown fields or flowerful closes, Green pleasure or grey grief;
If love were what the rose is, And I were like the leaf.
